about_the_game:
If you enjoy CyberMaid and want to support the continued development of this game (as well as our future projects), this Supporter Pack is the perfect choice for you.

This pack includes a nude version of the character ✨, created as special content exclusively for our supporters.

🔔 Important Note: Purchasing this DLC means you’re supporting our creative and development work. It does not offer any gameplay advantages, rewards, or enhancements.

💡 Special Notice: This DLC is support-oriented content and will never go on sale or be discounted in the future. We deeply appreciate every player who chooses to support us—thank you for your generosity!

content_descriptors.notes: This DLC features a fully nude, female-presenting android character as a desktop companion. The character follows the mouse cursor with her eyes and head, includes soft-body physics, and offers limited interactive responses. Moaning sounds are triggered during interactions, but there is no sexual activity, narrative content, or spoken dialogue. This is purely decorative content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Six-core Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
